name: Playback Handoff
author: Wouter
description: Spotify-style 'continue on another device': mirrors what each user is playing, on any client, into their server play queue so the next client resumes at the same track and position.

refreshSeconds.title: Position refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: While a track plays, how often the saved position is moved forward. Lower is more precise for clients that only report track starts.

users.reason: Receive playback events for the users assigned to this plugin

subsonicapi.reason: Read and save each user's play queue, and look up a track's album to rebuild album queues

scheduler.reason: Periodically advance the saved position while a track is playing

cache.reason: Remember the last playback report per user
